Excellent Bánh Mì
Mar 2023
My husband and I were so lucky to find this Bánh Mì place in Hanoi's Old Quarter. It is a little off the beaten track and we only happened onto it while shopping for traditional Vietnamese sweets across the street. We tried two different types of Bánh Mì which were both delicious as I am sure everything else is in this restaurant. All ingredients are fresh and tasty. The shop owner is very nice as is her son who speaks English and who sometimes helps out his mother. I hope to go back one day to try the other things on the menu. There are other Bánh Mì places closer to the cathedral, but this one is by far superior.
